families.name: Typewritten Standard English (1960s - 1980s)
families.definition: Monospaced typewritten text on paper, single-column narrative with structured tabular schedules.
families.evidence: Visual layout inspection of 30 representative PDFs showing 10CPI/12CPI typewriter font patterns and carbon impression artifacts.

families.name: Typeset Modern English (1990s - 2010s)
families.definition: Clean printed typeset documents with clear section headers, numbered paragraphs, and multi-column financial/Khasra tables.
families.evidence: High-contrast digital/offset print typography, sharp grid boundaries in Khasra tables.

families.name: Hindi / Bilingual Typeset (2000s - Present)
families.definition: Bilingual (Hindi/English) or Hindi Devnagari typeset narrative with numerical Khasra and Khatauni schedules.
families.evidence: Unicode Devnagari font glyphs mixed with Arabic numerals in Khasra schedules.

families.name: Low-Resolution / Cyclostyled / Heavy Scan
families.definition: Faded cyclostyled or heavy scan density documents with hand-written marginalia requiring specialized OCR pre-processing.
families.evidence: Heavy background noise, faded ink bleeding, and skewed page orientation.

families.name: Unclassified / Insufficient Evidence
families.definition: Documents where downloadable PDF payload was not directly accessible (View-Only / No-Link entries) or visual evidence was insufficient.
families.evidence: View-only external links or missing PDF payloads prevent definitive structural layout classification.
